title: Billing Basis of a Sister Electric Service Agreement
content:
The billing basis of a sister agreement, the customer's other active Electric Service Agreement on the new agreement's rate schedule that carries or carried the customer's Security Deposit of the same kind, follows its recent load.

**Means and usage.** Means are of the sister agreement's regular bills issued in the stated months ending on the assessment date, each rounded to the cent: the recent mean over 3 months, the six-month mean over 6 months and the twelve-month mean over 12 months. The twelve-month average kWh is the total kWh of the twelve-month regular bills over their number; the latest kWh are those on the sister agreement's latest regular bill.

| Recent load of the sister agreement | Billing basis |
|---|---|
| The recent mean exceeds the twelve-month mean times 1.25, and the latest kWh exceed the twelve-month average kWh | The recent mean |
| The recent mean is below the twelve-month mean times 0.75, and the latest kWh are below the twelve-month average kWh | The six-month mean |
| Otherwise | The twelve-month mean |

## Cases (hypothetical sister agreement: twelve-month mean USD 160.00, twelve-month average 1100 kWh)

| Recent mean (USD) | Latest kWh | Six-month mean (USD) | Billing basis (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 210.00 (above 200.00) | 1450 | 185.00 | 210.00 |
| 210.00 (above 200.00) | 1050 | 185.00 | 160.00 |
| 200.00 (not above 200.00) | 1450 | 180.00 | 160.00 |
| 110.00 (below 120.00) | 800 | 130.00 | 130.00 |
